div.div: προσαπό-δοσις , εως, ἡ, a Rhet. figure, by which when two or more statements follow one another, the reason for each is given (a) after each statement, or (b) after the whole series, Quint. Inst. 9.3.94 , Rutil. 1.1 .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
